Build passes now. Exit 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new config loader leaves it `undefined`, not `false`. Absent now means off.

The 8 warnings are all deprecation notices. Real cleanup work, but not blocking.
